title: Radicle team affiliation payload
description: Value of the xyz.radicle.teams payload in a repository's identity document. It records the teams that this repository asserts cover it. The payload is optional; its absence carries no meaning.

version.description: Schema version of this payload. Moves only when the meaning of an existing field changes; additive evolution happens through new optional fields at the same version. A client seeing a version greater than it understands must still recognise the payload as a team affiliation, but must not interpret its contents.

teams.description: RIDs of the team repositories this repository asserts cover it. May be empty, which asserts no affiliation.

rid.description: A repository identifier: rad: followed by a multibase base58btc encoding (leading z) of a Git object identifier. Bounded to the SHA-1 object format, the only one Radicle defines today; a new object format will require a new bound.
